description: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different models. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 8, with a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis represents BLEU scores, also on a linear scale, spanning from 20 to 30, with a tick label interval of 2. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different model: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (magenta dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with diamond markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at around 20 BLEU at an AL of 1 and increases to approximately 29 at an AL of 8. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at around 22 BLEU at an AL of 1 and rises to about 29.5 at an AL of 8. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line commences at roughly 22.5 BLEU at an AL of 1 and reaches approximately 29.5 at an AL of 8. The Consistency-Bi line starts at around 25 BLEU at an AL of 1 and ascends to about 30.5 at an AL of 8. All lines exhibit an upward trend as Average Lagging increases.
